summary: Full-stack review of Croiss'Marche (FastAPI + MongoDB + Expo RN Web). Backend: 26/26 integration tests + 11/11 engine unit tests PASS. Frontend: login (3 roles), walker home (152 CC, PREMIUM badge, partners sorted by distance with windowText + availableNow), voucher creation at Le Fournil du Castillet (code 2617 with 10-min countdown), double-active refusal ('Tu as déjà une contremarque active'), partner numeric keypad validation with green success overlay ('Contremarque validée · 1 chouquette · Minimum 2,50 € · CLIENT FIDÈLE'), and admin dashboard/dev panel all work end-to-end. French formatting correct throughout: narrow-space thousands ('3 053'), currency '2,50 €' / '297,00 €', windows '14h00 à 17h00'; no English strings and no euro value ever shown next to CC. 500 m exclusivity returns 409 and force=true succeeds. Signup refuses without RGPD consent.

issues: Test-created partners (TEST_ExclForced_*) appear as EN PAUSE rows because DELETE /api/admin/partners/{id} only pauses (soft delete). Not a bug per PRD (soft-delete is intentional), but consider hiding paused test rows or adding a real hard-delete for cleanup.

action_items: (Optional) Add hard-delete endpoint for admin to purge test partners, or filter EN PAUSE rows from the 'Validations par partenaire' widget.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py = 619 lines — close to the 700-line ceiling; consider splitting walker / partner / admin routers into separate modules if it grows further.
Pydantic model DevAgeBody allows monthsAgo=0 which is fine, but there is no bound (could be negative). Add ge=0 to be safe.
PartnerBody.offPeakDays uses a mutable default list; pydantic v2 handles it but consider default_factory=list for clarity.
seed_data_creation: TestVoucherFlow injects 240 CC into Marie via /admin/dev/age-cc to guarantee voucher creation. TestAdmin.test_500m_exclusivity_conflict_then_force creates one 'TEST_ExclForced_*' partner then soft-deletes it (leaves EN PAUSE rows in admin dashboard).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL = https://croiss-marche.preview.emergentagent.com. Password for all seeded accounts = croissant123. Le Fournil du Castillet (contact@castillet.fr) has a 07:00-21:00 window every day so voucher create+validate works anytime; the other 5 bakeries are 14:00-17:00 weekdays only. Run all backend tests via: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v -o addopts=''.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. All 7 areas in the review (auth, walker home, voucher create/refuse, partner validate incl. double + wrong bakery, partner stats/billing/settings, admin metrics/users/partners+exclusivity, admin dev panel) pass both API and UI checks.
